digest.component_or_area: bridge runner and multi-provider CI orchestration
propositions: Create a runner-neutral bridge entrypoint that accepts MODE vocabulary (reconcile-check, dry-run, bootstrap-strict, bootstrap-throttle, live) and routes to canonical bridge commands while preserving legacy 3/4/75 exit codes only at the wrapper boundary.

Replace provider-specific gh workflow disable/enable with durable pause refs using read_pause_with_oid CAS seam so fsck/doctor repair paths block scheduled bridge sync identically across local, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab, and bare environments.

Implement fail-closed repair-owned pause semantics with per-invocation unique tokens, foreign-pause abort, and operator-only recovery so pre-existing or changed pauses are never automatically reclaimed or cleared by another actor.
Validate shallow clone upfront with exact exit 2 and stderr before any bridge operation and reject repositories missing full git history.
Commit portable GHA/Jenkins/GitLab wrapper configs that parse offline against vendor schemas, extract and lint shell bodies, and cross-check exit tables and secret names against runner constants.
